findings.claim: New startup log calls s.search.TotalDocs(), which ranges over bleveBackend.cache without cacheMu while the already-started watch goroutine (search.go:207-213) can write the map via handleEvent -> getOrCreateIndex -> BuildIndex; concurrent map iteration and write is a fatal, unrecoverable Go runtime error. The narrowed lock also lets up to index_workers builds write the cache in parallel while BleveIndexMetrics.Collect (bleve_index_metrics.go:96) calls TotalDocs on every scrape.
findings.evidence: bleve.go:144-146 iterates b.cache with no lock; bleve.go:137-139 writes under cacheMu.Lock(). Reasoned; proposed red check: go test -race ./pkg/storage/unified/search/ with concurrent BuildIndex for distinct keys and a TotalDocs loop. Not run (benchmark mode).
findings.reason: Fatal crash path with a source-cited reader/writer pair; take cacheMu.RLock() in TotalDocs.

findings.claim: The patch skips the only postgres integration test of the storage-server target instead of fixing it. Root cause: the test hardcodes db_host=localhost for postgres (line 76) while Drone runs postgres at host 'postgres'; eager Init now opens and migrates the DB in NewResourceServer, so the wrong host is hit at startup where it was previously never used.
findings.evidence: module_server_test.go:35-38 adds t.Skip; mysql branch of the same helper already parses the host (line 81); .drone.yml:1155 POSTGRES_HOST: postgres; branch history 29db0d39b0/1095580dce/45e0089891/6f4d70876a shows timing workarounds then a skip. Check: remove skip and run GRAFANA_TEST_DB=postgres POSTGRES_HOST=postgres go test ./pkg/server -run TestIntegrationWillRunInstrumentationServerWhenTargetHasNoHttpServer. Not run.
findings.reason: Skip hides the regression surface of this exact change; read host from POSTGRES_HOST (as sqlutil.go:138 does) and drop the skip.

findings.claim: With search enabled, indexes above index_file_threshold (default 10) are created via bleve.New(dir) under a deterministic path relative to cwd (index_path default ''); bleve v2 returns ErrorIndexPathExists when the directory exists and nothing removes/reopens it. Previously this surfaced lazily as a request error; with eager Init it makes NewResourceServer fail, so Grafana fails to boot on every restart after the first.
findings.evidence: bleve.go:98 index, err = bleve.New(dir, mapper); setting_unified_storage.go:41-44 defaults; RV-reuse logic is still a TODO (bleve.go:100). bleve ErrorIndexPathExists behaviour is from reviewer knowledge of v2.4.3, module source not available. Unverified; check: start a search-enabled storage server twice against the same index_path with a resource of >10 objects.
findings.reason: Accepted as unverified Important: pre-existing logic that this patch promotes to a boot failure; needs the restart repro to confirm before fixing (reopen existing index or clear the dir).

findings.claim: Eager Init now runs inside the wire graph for every Grafana process (ProvideUnifiedStorageClient -> sql.NewResourceServer, always consumed by apiserver.ProvideService), so resource-store migrations, DB ping, a 100ms poller and (if enabled) the full search build run at boot on context.Background() with no deadline; a DB or search failure/hang now blocks Grafana startup instead of only failing unified-storage requests.
findings.evidence: pkg/storage/unified/client.go:100, pkg/services/apiserver/service.go:147, sql/backend.go:28 defaultPollingInterval. Reasoned; no test.
findings.reason: This is the stated intent of the branch (dont-lazy-init); whether the boot-time blast radius and lack of a startup deadline are acceptable is an owner decision, not a code defect. Check: boot Grafana with an unreachable/hanging resource DB and observe startup behaviour.

findings.claim: Removing every per-request s.Init(ctx) removed the only reader of initErr after startup: Stop still sets initErr to 'service is stopping/stopped' but handlers (Create/Update/Delete/Read/List/Watch/Search/History/Origin/IsHealthy/PutBlob/GetBlob) no longer reject requests after Stop, and IsHealthy reports healthy while stopped. The initErr writes in Stop are now dead.
findings.evidence: grep initErr pkg/storage/unified/resource/*.go: only Init and Stop touch it; no test asserts post-Stop rejection. Stop is not on the ResourceServer interface and has no external callers, so impact is low.
findings.reason: Normalised to Minor (no external Stop callers per correctness seats); either gate handlers on a stopped flag or delete the dead initErr writes so the code stops implying a guarantee it no longer gives.

findings.claim: On Init failure NewResourceServer returns without calling s.cancel() or lifecycle.Stop; if search.init succeeded and initWatcher failed, the search watch goroutine and its sql poller leak.
findings.evidence: server.go:258-262 returns err without cleanup; search goroutine started at search.go:204-212 on context.Background(). Reasoned.
findings.reason: Small, local: cancel/stop on the error path.

findings.claim: The init error is logged twice with the identical message 'error initializing resource server' (inside Init at server.go:313-315 and again in NewResourceServer) and then also returned to the caller.
findings.evidence: server.go:260 and server.go:314 carry the same message and key.
findings.reason: Drop the constructor log; the error is returned.

findings.claim: Pre-existing data race in searchSupport.init: errgroup workers write the shared outer err and totalBatchesIndexed++ unsynchronized; the patch's narrowed BleveIndex lock makes the builds truly parallel so the race fires more often and a build error can be lost.
findings.evidence: search.go:189-190; previously BuildIndex held cacheMu for the whole build, serialising most work. Reasoned; check: go test -race on init with >=2 stats rows.
findings.reason: Patch increases exposure; use a goroutine-local err and an atomic counter.

findings.claim: With the function-wide lock removed, concurrent builds of the same key (Search request and handleEvent both seeing a nil index in getOrCreateIndex) overlap more easily; last writer wins and documents written to the discarded index are lost.
findings.evidence: search.go:288-306 check-then-act with no per-key guard; bleve.go:137-139. Both seats note the old lock never re-checked the cache, so the lost write pre-exists.
findings.reason: ponytail: pre-existing check-then-act race, not introduced by this patch; fix with per-key singleflight in a follow-up.

findings.claim: sync.Once and initErr gating are now dead scaffolding: Init has one caller (the constructor), *server is unexported and Init is not on the ResourceServer interface, so the once guard can never be hit twice.
findings.evidence: grep -rn '\.Init(' pkg --include=*.go finds only server.go:258 for this type (apistore/watcher_test.go:148 calls backend Init, not server Init).
findings.reason: ponytail: advisory simplification (~12-15 lines); resolve together with the Stop/initErr finding rather than as a separate churn.

findings.claim: No test covers the new contract that NewResourceServer returns lifecycle/search/watcher init errors, or that handlers work without lazy Init; apistore/watcher_test.go:148 still calls Init manually before construction (now redundant).
findings.evidence: Patch touches no test except the skip; contribute/create-pull-request.md:22 requires tests verifying intended behaviour.
findings.reason: ponytail: test-coverage gap; the restored postgres integration test (module_server_test.go finding) covers the happy startup path; failure-path test is a follow-up.

findings.claim: New log line breaks contribute/backend/instrumentation.md conventions: message should start with a capital letter and keys should be camelCase (durationSecs, totalDocs).
findings.reason: Every other s.log call in resource/search.go and resource/server.go uses lowercase messages and snake_case keys (seat's own evidence); changing one line breaks local consistency for no behavioural gain. Package-wide convention cleanup is out of scope.

findings.claim: Two TODOs added without owner or issue link (bleve.go:100 and module_server_test.go:35).
findings.evidence: Seat states no documented Grafana Go rule covers TODO format.
findings.reason: No documented standard is breached (seat concedes); the test-skip TODO is subsumed by the accepted module_server_test.go finding.

findings.claim: Commit subjects ('dont lazy init unified storage', 'linter fix') do not follow contribute/create-pull-request.md Chris Beams style / '<Area>: <Summary>' PR title.
findings.reason: Not a code finding: Grafana squash-merges, so only the PR title lands; the seat itself notes it matters only if the PR title is not fixed. Anchored to a repo file only because the ledger requires a path.
